pages.title: About
pages.markdown:
## Our story

Your Brand started with a spreadsheet nobody trusted. Three of us lost a week every quarter reconciling it, so we built the tool we wished we had: small, fast and honest about what it does not know. The first version had one customer and one dashboard. It still runs on the same idea.

## How we work

We work in small teams that own a problem from the first sketch to the support inbox. Decisions are written down before they are argued about, and anything that takes more than a week gets cut in half.

## Life here

A week at Your Brand is mostly writing, building and talking to customers. We work from wherever people do their best work and meet in person twice a year.

## Where we are going

The next chapter is making the product as good for a team of fifty as it is for a team of five, without making it heavier for either.
